question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

CUSTOMER : YQWXKIIV :: COMMERCIAL : ?
solution:
Table shows the positional value of alphabets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aaf7cf6ab63749d465eac96eaedeb37e5e3bf6c9033aa3015365ce5a2f5241f.png] 

__**Logic:**__

**First two are decreased by 4 and next two letters are increased by 4 and so on.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abd48bfeb793df89887cfb98e2f17b00cb08f247a09d2a66d2b66cabb9dce7e6.png] **

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e850be5cdee8c22565dd77eaf905291501a8d5b9d57f9e86aab5df73c595bee7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"YKQQANGMWH".**
